title: UI item focus by ID
summary: Recover the eligibility-gated depth-first focus lookup at 0x448180, including its virtual callback and early return.
test_description: Compare the original and recovered methods on root, descendant, duplicate and absent IDs; eligibility flag combinations, alternate eligibility, empty and pruned subtrees, and state 3. Compare return values, callback receiver and arguments, callback mutations and other item bytes; verify FS head after each original call.
known_limits: Object field and callback semantic names are provisional; only observed offsets and arguments are established.
Tests use controlled callbacks and valid acyclic child ranges; malformed objects and callback-driven tree mutation are not exercised.
Recovered source is behaviorally tested, not claimed byte-identical.
